snippet.title: Bomberman Land (PS1) - Longplay
snippet.description:
Bomberman Land (ボンバーマンランド) is a video game for the PlayStation. This game is the first in the series to feature various minigames instead of just the usual grid-like gameplay. It was released only in Japan. It is the first entry in the Bomberman Land series.

Very old video, here is the series updated and with the locations of all of them much faster!! look at the description to see all the pieces 
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL1TqYSMthW3V8PM1TUw66oaBQmy4ftHUs&si=xAU9VaP56qOkWsvk
